title: Train the conditional VAE baseline E0
outcome: Establish a lower-cost generative baseline with the agreed action inputs.
acceptance: Condition on the first frame, selected-object mask, and numeric force.
Define the posterior, prior, reconstruction loss, and KL weight; sample from the prior without future frames at inference.
Pass a tiny-batch overfit check and produce four seeded samples per condition.
Log validation results, model size, training cost, and checkpoint selection.
Add a run manifest and qualitative successes/failures.
progress: A 574,659-parameter conditional video VAE, learned prior/posterior, future-only L1 plus KL with warmup, TC2-only trainer, checkpoint/resume, and four-seed prior sampler are implemented. Both dataset-0.1 and dataset-0.2 work through the same checked split index. A native 1.1 wall-force condition passes loader normalization and four-video untrained prior export. CPU checks do not establish model quality. TC2 tiny-batch overfitting, GPU resume, trained samples, and measured budgets remain pending.

title: Implement first-frame and numeric-action diffusion E1/E2
outcome: Create the common diffusion backbone and the main numeric-action baseline.
acceptance: Implement pixel video training and DDIM sampling with a shared backbone/configuration.
Support first-frame-only E1 and selected-mask-plus-numeric-force E2.
Pass forward/backward, tiny-batch overfit, and checkpoint resume checks.
Measure 64px peak VRAM, seconds/step, and four-sample inference latency.
Record baseline samples and proposed run budgets.
progress: Trainer, sampler, EMA and full checkpoint implemented. Exact CPU continuation passes with/without auxiliary losses; cross-job A40 continuation matched with zero tensor difference in jobs 42909/42910. Four-clip, 2000-step pilot reduced fixed training-noise MSE from 1.02554 to 0.01965, but generated clips remain noisy and 0/248 future object observations were trackable. Tiny-overfit and held-out action-response gates remain open. Follow-up jobs 42917 (10000-step epsilon) and 42920 (2000-step velocity) completed. Longer epsilon still failed tracking; velocity reduced visible noise but recovered only 1-7/62 observations. Tiny-overfit remains open. Next isolate a deterministic single clip, noise-level reconstruction and precision. Evidence: docs/results/diffusion_debug_2026-10-16.json.
